description: UNICA AI Effectiveness - auto-resolution rate, handoff rate, knowledge hit rate, top questions

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'closed' AND handoff_count = 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS resolution_rate FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$__interval' AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line')

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE handoff_count > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS handoff_rate FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$__interval' AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$__interval' AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line')

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (metadata->>'dify_retrieval_hit')::boolean = true)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('ai_processing', 'closed') AND handoff_count = 0), 0), 4) AS hit_rate FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '$__interval' AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line')

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'closed' AND handoff_count = 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS resolution_rate FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE handoff_count > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS handoff_rate FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(pl.name, c.product_line_id::text) AS product_line, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.state = 'closed' AND c.handoff_count = 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS resolution_rate FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN product_lines pl ON pl.id = c.product_line_id WHERE c.created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND c.created_at < $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY resolution_rate DESC

WITH first_msgs AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.conversation_id) COALESCE(c.intent_summary, m.content_json->>'text', LEFT(m.content_json::text, 200)) AS question FROM messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.direction = 'inbound' AND m.sender_type = 'customer' AND m.created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND m.created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR c.product_line_id::text = '$product_line') ORDER BY m.conversation_id, m.created_at ASC) SELECT question, COUNT(*) AS count FROM first_msgs WHERE question IS NOT NULL AND question != '' GROUP BY question ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'closed' AND handoff_count = 0) AS ai_resolved, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE handoff_count > 0) AS handoffs, COUNT(*) AS total FROM conversations WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND ($product_line = '' OR product_line_id::text = '$product_line') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

list.name: product_line
list.label: Product Line
list.query: SELECT id::text AS __value, name AS __text FROM product_lines ORDER BY name
